evidence_type: Primary human-cell study with pretreated-cell transplantation into a mouse renal-injury model; not a human treatment or oral PK study

grouping.unit_warning: Replicate wells, fields, donors and mice cannot be pooled as independent samples; same-unit proxy/function pairing is not established here

observations.direction: decreased in obese MSCs; increased in lean MSCs
p16, p21 and TNF-alpha gene expression increased

observations.context: mouse stenotic kidney after cell administration
observations.direction: obese-MSC deficit not rescued; several lean-MSC improvements blunted
selected reported oxygenation benefit retained, including obese-MSC medullary comparison
observations.interpretation_limit: Source Figure 4 caption's T2-star/oxygenation direction is not independently resolved here; no raw MRI reanalysis

observations.direction: volume improved across MSC groups; not specific proof of MOTS-c benefit
pretreatment failed to establish integrated repair; fibrosis and lean-MSC injury outcomes were unfavorable

limitations: Pharmacological cell pretreatment does not establish systemic exposure effects
Selected endpoints differ by donor state
No numerical effect sizes extracted from plot images
No dental-cell or clinical treatment inference
No raw-data access or contact request was made
